name: Midnight Sun
author: RoWey
description: Time the final pick orb very late at 43% and then start spamming to be able to enter the wave portal and skip the dual portal. Stay at a level that is above the wave and dual portal until 45% where you can hold to the floor while being close to the slope. Fall up between the slopes at 46% after getting the size portal and then stay above the slope but below the spikes until 47% where you can stay at the ceiling. Skip the ship portal at 85% and then play the following section as the wave until you reach the reverse gravity mini portal at 89% where you can then immediately hold to the floor. Continue holding at the floor until 96%. Free to the end from there.
